title: How to resume Gemma stabilization without repeating Phase 3 mistakes
summary: Use the current-state record and Phase 3 corpus as negative/continuity evidence. Re-establish the exact training/runtime baseline elsewhere before claiming a new current candidate; this sphere does not itself prove that later artifacts remain current.
procedure: Resolve the actual current Gemma artifact/runtime before training or promotion.
Run substantive code and English gates, not compile/loss gates alone.
Record any new promotion/rejection evidence as a new versioned corpus/current-state update.
invariants: Do not silently treat this imported Phase 3 candidate as newer than an independently qualified later Gemma artifact.
A handover must distinguish historical experimental evidence from the presently resolved artifact frontier.
